definitions.explanation: Physically lacking space; too small or narrow.
Feeling restricted or unable to relax, often due to social formality.

examples.japanese: この{靴|くつ}は{窮屈|きゅうくつ}だ。
{規則|きそく}が{多|おお}くて{窮屈|きゅうくつ}に{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel constrained because there are too many rules.

examples.japanese: {窮屈|きゅうくつ}な{姿勢|しせい}で{座|すわ}っていた。
examples.english: I was sitting in an uncomfortable position.

notes:
FORMS:
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}な + noun (adnominal)
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}に (adverbial)
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}だ (predicative)

FORMATION:
{窮|きゅう} (to be in difficulty) + {屈|くつ} (to bend)

USAGE:
Physical sense:
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}な{部屋|へや} (cramped room)
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}な{服|ふく} (tight clothing)

Psychological sense:
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}な{雰囲気|ふんいき} (uncomfortable atmosphere)
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}な{生活|せいかつ} (constrained lifestyle)
・{窮屈|きゅうくつ}な{関係|かんけい} (stiff relationship)

ANTONYM:
・{ゆったり} - spacious, relaxed
